title: NMI Reviewer Output Schema (calibration baseline, P2.T001)
description: Fixed machine-parseable per-reviewer output for the direction-72 calibration baseline. Extends the existing NMI rubric (grade, key_concerns, questions_for_authors, calibration_check) with 12 quantifiable per-metric 1-10 integers (each with a one-sentence justification) plus a 0-1 publishability_probability. Captured one reviewer per record; 5 reviewers x 16 papers x 2 panels = 160 such records per the P2/P3 plan.

grade.description: NMI grade verbatim from the existing rubric.

summary.description: 2-4 sentence overall assessment, verbatim from the existing rubric.

calibration_check.description: One sentence: are the claims appropriately scoped vs. the evidence?

metrics.description: Fixed 12-metric panel; each metric is a 1-10 integer with a short justification string. Required to be present and complete on every reviewer output.

publishability_probability.description: Float in [0,1]: reviewer's calibrated probability that the manuscript, as submitted, would be accepted at NMI after the standard editorial process. Separate from `grade` (categorical) and from `metrics.overall_recommendation` (1-10 score).

score.description: 1-10 integer. 1=worst, 10=best, on the NMI Articles bar.

justification.description: One short sentence grounding the score in concrete manuscript evidence.
